scope: Govern the newly integrated ST052-M linear temporal transform spec serialization without relabelling transform metadata as a complete saved velocity candidate.

inherited_governance.parent_identity_rule: A deterministic materialized ST052-M parent evaluator with immutable artifact/candidate identity must be bound beyond caller-supplied candidate/source strings.
inherited_governance.temporal_semantics_rule: The time law is part of candidate identity and its chain-rule time derivative prevents inheritance of static/parent PDE receipts.

requirements_before_temporal_child_expor: assign immutable parent artifact or candidate SHA and bind it at runtime
compose parent identity, static transform identity, and temporal transform identity into a versioned child manifest
assign a complete child candidate ID and SHA
save and reload the complete child so the same parent plus transforms are reconstructed without an externally supplied unauthenticated callable
replay the unified velocity(x,y,z,t) API after reload and verify finite pointwise equality
keep visual correspondence and PDE validation as independent claim states

source_classification.item: qualitative observable structure of the published OpenAI velocity-field visualization
ST052-M local-swirl transform and linear temporal activation, including serialization layout
exact OpenAI numerical field, hidden coefficients, exact frame/time map, camera and trajectory seeds

truth_boundary: A transform-spec checksum identifies only that transform specification, not the externally supplied parent field or a complete velocity candidate.
Saving and loading the temporal spec does not serialize the ST052-M parent evaluator and therefore is not complete candidate save/load.
A callable adapter around an externally injected parent may be useful before the complete child is versioned; this does not make that child velocity_export_ready.
PDE failure or pending PDE work does not block a future honestly labelled complete callable/save-load velocity delivery.
Target-free morphology or fixed-render evidence does not establish visual_correspondence_verified.
Neither the ST052-M transform route nor canonical Eq45 is the exact OpenAI numerical field without independent public evidence.
